_note: The Skill Router only picks skills from this list. A call to an unlisted skill falls to user approval in the Policy Gate. '@key' in 'output' is a folder in governance/paths.json. Triggers stay bilingual because users write in Turkish.

skills.name: log-analysis
skills.purpose: Find attack traces in local log files and write an evidence-backed report
required_input: local path of the log file

skills.name: config-audit
skills.purpose: Audit configuration files read-only against a security checklist
required_input: local path of the config file

skills.name: cve-research
skills.purpose: Collect CVE/vulnerability information from primary sources and record it in quarantine

skills.name: incident-response
skills.purpose: Review host evidence exported by the user (crontab, systemd, authorized_keys, accounts/sudoers, SUID, ps/ss/last, copies of suspicious files) read-only and write persistence traces, IOCs and a timeline into an evidence-backed incident response report
required_input: local path of the evidence folder
skills.risk_reason: No network access, read-only. Input contains possibly malicious file copies and sensitive host data; writing to the evidence folder is denied by the Policy Gate (@evidence). Bash is limited to hash/count tools for this agent (policy.json agent_shell, stage 2).
